explorer.name: Richard Stuart
explorer.biography: Richard Stuart was a Hudson's Bay Company servant who accompanied William Stuart on inland expeditions from York Factory in the early 18th century. He was among the first Europeans to travel extensively into the interior of Rupert's Land, establishing crucial trade relationships with Indigenous nations.
explorer.notableAchievements: Early inland exploration from York Factory, trade relationship building with Indigenous peoples
